name: Love x Love = Falling Love!
original_name: らぶ×らぶ＝ふぉーりんらぶ！
source:
"Yes, yes, then I'll declare it!
Ren Igarashi, the god of beauty of all things in nature, wants to have a romance! "

Ren Igarashi, the protagonist who is self-respecting and terrible.
And unfortunately, it was Chitose and Hyakuhana, the twin brothers and sisters who were childhood friends, who were locked on as the target of the romance.
Of course, the two who had been made into toys for goodwill refused categorically.
Therefore, Ren proposes a game.
The approach will be applied for a week, so if you endure it, the twins will win. I give up on them once.
However, if either one fails, the goodwill wins. Both of them are goodwill toys for the rest of their lives.

"Ah, don't fall down, Hundred Flowers ...!"
"... Chitose will end when it falls"

[Taken from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/21514]Freem![/url]]
